claims.claim: This is a girst grade Tokumbo tires that will last almost like new brand ones.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show tread pattern and sidewall area, but no fully readable brand/model text and no DOT/age or proof of 'Tokumbo' grade.
No photo evidence relates to availability or urgency.
Photos show deep grooves, but the witness did not measure tread depth and no measurement tool/number is shown.
Photos do not show the full tire surface including inside/repair areas; no patch is clearly visible in the provided close-ups.
Witness did not report a full sidewall/bulge inspection; only close-ups of tread/sidewall area are shown.
No DOT date code or manufacturing date is shown/readable in the witness report.

risks.risk: Exact tire size and fitment (width/aspect ratio/rim diameter) are unknown, which can make the tire unusable or force a different purchase.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the full sidewall showing the complete size and load/speed rating (e.g., 205/55R16 91V) and the full brand/model text.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown-size used tire (worst-case fitment risk) until size/load/speed are confirmed.

risks.risk: Brand/model and specific tire type are not fully readable (only partial “MAX…” is visible), affecting expected quality and resale value.
risks.proof: A sharp, straight-on sidewall photo where the full brand and model name are readable.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest value tier for generic/unknown used tires with similar tread appearance.

risks.risk: Tread depth claim ("90 percent") may be overstated; photos alone cannot confirm remaining tread depth.
risks.proof: A tread-depth measurement photo/video using a gauge (showing mm at multiple points) or a clear measurement report.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not-confirmed tread condition (worst-case within used range) rather than near-new.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or repairs (inside punctures, patches, belt issues) may exist even if tread looks good.
risks.proof: Photos of the entire sidewall (both sides), bead area, and tread surface plus a photo of the inside surface; ideally a quick spin/inspection video showing no bubbles and no embedded objects.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'used, condition unknown' with potential repair/air-holding risk.

risks.risk: Age/seasoning and DOT date are unknown; older tires can look fine but have cracking risk and reduced lifespan.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the DOT code (date week/year) on the sidewall.
risks.if_unproven: Price as older used tires until DOT date is verified.

risks.risk: Quantity is unclear (witness shows two tread faces together, but total set count is unknown).
risks.proof: A photo showing all tires available laid out together with count visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price per tire as a single/uncertain quantity item, not as a full set.

risks.risk: Air-holding/valve and leak status is unknown; a tire can have good tread but still leak.
risks.proof: A short clip showing the tire inflated and holding air (or a test/soapy water check at the valve and sidewall).
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'may need re-inflation/repair' until leak status is confirmed.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the full sidewall showing complete size and load/speed rating (not partial text).
Send a clear photo where the full brand and model name are readable.
Send the DOT date code photo (week/year).
Provide tread-depth measurements in mm at 3–4 points (photo/video with a gauge).
Show both sidewalls fully and the bead area for cuts, cracks, or bulges (photos of entire circumference).
Show the inside surface and any repair/patch areas (photos/video).
Confirm quantity available (photo showing all tires together).
Show proof it holds air (short clip of inflation and/or valve/soapy-water leak check).
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a car tire with good-looking tread, but key pricing drivers (exact size/load rating, brand/model, DOT age, measured tread depth, and damage/air-holding status) are not verifiable from the provided shots. Without those, any worst-case price would be too unreliable.
